counting_rule: Architecture elements are responsibility, contract, state, or runtime units; files and functions are anchors only.

shared_elements.name: Voice Model Binding
shared_elements.responsibility: Translate the fixed VIA Voice contract to the selected S2S dependency.
shared_elements.change_when: S2S invocation or event adaptation behavior changes

shared_elements.name: Voice Event Contract
shared_elements.responsibility: Define normalized speech, timing, generation, interruption, and completion events.
shared_elements.independence: Versioned event meaning independent of provider wire format
shared_elements.change_when: Voice event meaning or lifecycle changes

shared_elements.name: S2S Runtime Binding
shared_elements.responsibility: Manage the one S2S runtime connection and lifecycle.
shared_elements.change_when: Execution location, startup, recovery, or communication coupling changes

shared_elements.name: Semantic Model Client
shared_elements.responsibility: Invoke the one semantic LLM with bounded retries and return correlated results.
shared_elements.change_when: Invocation, streaming, retry, or session behavior changes

shared_elements.name: Semantic Inference Contract
shared_elements.responsibility: Define request, completion, error, cancellation, and correlation semantics for semantic inference.
shared_elements.change_when: Inference lifecycle or output envelope meaning changes

shared_elements.name: Model Session Mapping
shared_elements.responsibility: Map VIA conversation and request identities to provider session identities without transferring ownership.
shared_elements.change_when: Provider session identity, history, or restoration rules change

shared_elements.name: Semantic Runtime Binding
shared_elements.responsibility: Manage deployment, connection, startup, recovery, and resource accounting for the one semantic LLM.
shared_elements.boundary: Local or remote semantic model deployment
shared_elements.change_when: Execution location or lifecycle coupling changes

shared_elements.name: Context Adapter Registry
shared_elements.responsibility: Adapt allowed file, mail, calendar, browser, and screen sources to canonical evidence.
shared_elements.change_when: Source adaptation, selection, or provider behavior changes

shared_elements.name: Context Evidence Contract
shared_elements.responsibility: Define source identity, provenance, version, time, and consumable evidence semantics.
shared_elements.change_when: Evidence identity, provenance, geometry, or value meaning changes

shared_elements.name: Context Evidence Snapshot
shared_elements.responsibility: Own the request-scoped evidence set and its source revisions.
shared_elements.independence: Independent snapshot identity and staleness rules
shared_elements.change_when: Evidence lifetime, revision, or retention rules change

shared_elements.name: Agent Integration Adapter
shared_elements.responsibility: Translate canonical delegation and lifecycle operations to external Agent protocols.
shared_elements.change_when: Protocol, status, control, result, or authentication adaptation changes

shared_elements.name: Agent Capability Registry
shared_elements.responsibility: Register available Agent capabilities and their required inputs and lifecycle support.
shared_elements.change_when: Capability registration or compatibility behavior changes

shared_elements.name: Agent Capability Contract
shared_elements.responsibility: Define capability identity, required input, version, and supported lifecycle semantics.
shared_elements.change_when: Capability identity, input, version, or lifecycle declaration changes

shared_elements.name: Agent Lifecycle Contract
shared_elements.responsibility: Define submit, follow-up, question, control, status, result, and error meaning.
shared_elements.boundary: External Agent lifecycle to VIA Task lifecycle
shared_elements.change_when: Execution identity or lifecycle operation meaning changes

shared_elements.name: Agent Authorization Contract
shared_elements.responsibility: Define credential scope, expiry, refresh, refusal, and user binding semantics.
shared_elements.change_when: Credential scope or lifecycle meaning changes

shared_elements.name: Agent Execution Link
shared_elements.responsibility: Own VIA Task to Agent conversation, run, question, control, and artifact identities.
shared_elements.change_when: Execution, question, control, or artifact identity model changes

shared_elements.name: Agent Authorization State
shared_elements.responsibility: Own active credential scope, expiry, refresh generation, and user binding.
shared_elements.change_when: Credential state or refresh rules change

shared_elements.name: Task State Owner
shared_elements.responsibility: Validate and commit Task transitions and external execution links.
shared_elements.boundary: Request and Agent observations to Task state
shared_elements.change_when: Task transition, binding, or control behavior changes

shared_elements.name: Task View Contract
shared_elements.responsibility: Expose versioned Task, pending interaction, and execution-link facts to semantic consumers.
shared_elements.independence: Stable read contract distinct from persistence format
shared_elements.change_when: Task view meaning or version changes

shared_elements.name: Task State
shared_elements.responsibility: Own Task identity, state, revision, pending interactions, and execution correlations.
shared_elements.change_when: Task schema, transition, or migration rules change

shared_elements.name: Conversation State
shared_elements.responsibility: Own user turns, actual responses, references, and Task relations.
shared_elements.independence: Distinct identity and retention rules from Task state
shared_elements.change_when: Conversation schema, relation, or migration rules change

shared_elements.name: User Memory State
shared_elements.responsibility: Own allowed remembered preferences, provenance, revision, and deletion state.
shared_elements.change_when: Memory schema, provenance, or deletion rules change

shared_elements.name: State Repository
shared_elements.responsibility: Read, write, validate, and recover Conversation, Task, link, and memory state.
shared_elements.change_when: Read, write, version, or recovery behavior changes

shared_elements.name: State Migrator
shared_elements.responsibility: Migrate persisted state versions while preserving identities and rollback safety.
shared_elements.change_when: Migration inputs, outputs, rollback, or validation change

shared_elements.name: Response Composer
shared_elements.responsibility: Compose truthful Voice and Text responses from direct, Task, and Agent outcomes.
shared_elements.change_when: Response selection, channel, or artifact behavior changes

shared_elements.name: Trace Recorder
shared_elements.responsibility: Record correlated execution events without becoming authoritative Task state.
shared_elements.change_when: Event capture, correlation, validation, or redaction changes

shared_elements.name: Trace Event Contract
shared_elements.responsibility: Define event identity, correlation, clock, schema version, and privacy fields.
shared_elements.change_when: Trace event meaning or version compatibility changes

shared_elements.name: Trace Evidence State
shared_elements.responsibility: Own immutable raw events, correlation indexes, and schema provenance.
shared_elements.change_when: Stored trace schema, index, or retention changes

shared_elements.name: Evidence Exporter
shared_elements.responsibility: Export raw evidence exactly once to local or analysis storage.
shared_elements.change_when: Export, retry, or destination behavior changes

shared_elements.name: Evidence Export Contract
shared_elements.responsibility: Define raw evidence batch, acknowledgement, retry, and deduplication semantics.
shared_elements.change_when: Delivery or acknowledgement meaning changes

shared_elements.name: Evidence Backend Binding
shared_elements.responsibility: Manage local file or analysis backend deployment and recovery coupling.
shared_elements.change_when: Destination deployment or communication coupling changes

shared_elements.name: Experiment Assigner
shared_elements.responsibility: Assign eligible requests to frozen experiment variants and record exposure.
shared_elements.change_when: Eligibility, assignment, or exposure recording changes

shared_elements.name: Experiment Assignment Contract
shared_elements.responsibility: Define experiment, variant, eligibility, assignment, and exposure identifiers.
shared_elements.change_when: Assignment or exposure meaning changes

shared_elements.name: Experiment Exposure State
shared_elements.responsibility: Own assignment and actual exposure records used for reproducible evaluation.
shared_elements.change_when: Exposure schema, retention, or deduplication changes

A.name: Integrated Semantic Coordinator
A.responsibility: Own and jointly correct the final goal, referent, Task relation, and handling decision.
A.boundary: Evidence and Task view to final semantic decision
A.change_when: Integrated semantic reasoning, correction, or validation behavior changes

A.name: Integrated Semantic Decision Contract
A.responsibility: Define the jointly versioned final goal, referent, Task relation, handling, and clarification outcome.
A.change_when: Final semantic fields, invariants, or correction meaning changes

B.name: Grounding Resolver
B.responsibility: Own goal, referent, and required-context meaning.
B.change_when: Grounding reasoning or correction behavior changes

B.name: Grounding Result Contract
B.responsibility: Define versioned goal, referent, constraints, and required-context result.
B.change_when: Grounding result meaning or version changes

B.name: Task Associator
B.responsibility: Own no-tracked, new, or existing Task relation meaning.
B.boundary: Grounding and Task view to Task relation
B.change_when: Task association or correction behavior changes

B.name: Task Relation Contract
B.responsibility: Define versioned Task identity, relation, revision, and pending interaction meaning.
B.change_when: Task relation output meaning or version changes

B.name: Handling Selector
B.responsibility: Own direct, delegated, control, and clarification handling and required capability.
B.boundary: Grounding and Task relation to execution handling
B.change_when: Handling, capability, or correction behavior changes

B.name: Handling Decision Contract
B.responsibility: Define versioned route, capability, action, and clarification outcome.
B.change_when: Handling output meaning or version changes

B.name: Semantic Correction Coordinator
B.responsibility: Return detected semantic conflicts to the owning stage and resume affected downstream stages.
B.change_when: Correction ownership, invalidation, or resume behavior changes

B.name: Semantic Correction Contract
B.responsibility: Define owner, prior version, conflict, invalidation, replacement, and resume semantics.
B.boundary: Downstream conflict to owning semantic stage
B.change_when: Correction request or resume meaning changes

B_PRIME.tactic_note: The deterministic fast path changes internal behavior but is not an independent Architecture element.
